paths: /opt (bounded asset search, maximum depth 6; Python executables maximum depth 7)

model_assets.limitations: Bounded filename and directory search; other paths, deeper files, other Python environments and externally hosted models were not exhaustively inspected.

hardware.cgroup_cpu_memory_limits: not available at conventional cgroup-v2 cpu.max/memory.max paths; no quota claim

feasibility.reason: Neither an inference runtime nor actual model weights were found in the checked scope. The existing CG vision module implements only a trusted local stdio protocol, not model inference.
feasibility.possible_next_step: After resource/setup authorization, select an official-source compact vision-capable model and compatible CPU runtime, account for its full weights plus image encoder and runtime memory, then benchmark one exact three-view/ref request under the existing 60-second call limit.
feasibility.inference_not_benchmark: A compact quantized CPU vision model may be feasible within observed resources; this has not been demonstrated. Do not claim that it can meet the current deadline or deliver reliable material/geometry review.
feasibility.cost: This audit used no paid API and made no model call. Future local inference has no model API charge if genuinely local, but infrastructure/resource cost and download/storage requirements are not established. A paid remote provider needs separately bounded permission.

required_acceptance: Actual local model consumes the exact three PNGs and optional reference bytes, not only their names or summaries.
Its returned findings are image-dependent, schema-valid and exactly hash-bound.
At least one review-change-render-review chain completes within persisted attempt/time/cost budgets.
Compare the automated conclusions against independently inspected known-bad and improved renders; a valid JSON response alone is not visual-review quality.
conclusion: Use the precise statement: no ready-to-run local vision model was found in this checked cloud environment. Do not generalize to user computers, private caches, other runtimes or all available providers.
